prompt: 哪一句連接詞用法正確？
options: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
Because it was cold, but we stayed home.
Although it was cold so we went swimming.
answer: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

wrong.Although it was cold, but we went swimmi: although 和 but 不能同時使用，中文可以，英文不行。
because 和 but 也不能一起用，而且 but 讓句意變成轉折。
wrong.Although it was cold so we went swimming: although 和 so 同樣不能並用，而且缺少逗號分隔兩個子句。

why: although 已經表示「雖然」，主要子句不再加 but。
tip: although 和 but 不能同時出現在一句話。
say: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

text: I took an umbrella _____ it might rain this afternoon.
options: because
but
or
so

wrong.but: but 表示轉折，帶傘與可能下雨不是轉折關係。
wrong.or: or 表示選擇，句子不是在二選一。
wrong.so: so 引出結果，但 it might rain 是原因，不是結果。

why: it might rain 是帶傘的原因，所以用 because 引導原因。
tip: because 後面接原因，so 後面接結果。
say: I took an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.

prompt: 你想說：「如果明天下雨，我們就待在家裡。」哪句最正確？
options: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
If it rains tomorrow, we stayed at home.
When it will rain tomorrow, we stay at home.
answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

wrong.If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay a: if 子句表示條件時，用現在式代替未來式，不加 will。
主要子句要用 will + 原形表示未來，不是過去式。
wrong.When it will rain tomorrow, we stay at h: 時間或條件子句不用 will，而且主要子句也不是未來。

why: if 條件子句用現在式，主要子句用 will + 原形動詞表示未來的結果。
tip: if 子句不加 will，用現在式表示未來。
say: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

text: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
options: 如果不快點，你會錯過公車
因為你很快，所以你會錯過公車
你會一直等公車
公車會因為你而延遲
answer: 如果不快點，你會錯過公車

wrong.因為你很快，所以你會錯過公車: unless 不是因為，而是「除非、如果不」。
wrong.你會一直等公車: 句子沒有說等車，只說會錯過。

why: unless 等於 if not，所以句子是「如果你不快點，就會錯過公車」。
tip: unless 的意思等於 if not。
say: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

prompt: 哪一句時間副詞子句正確？
options: I will call you when I arrive.
I will call you when I will arrive.
I will call you when I arrived.
I call you when I will arrive.
answer: I will call you when I arrive.

when 子句表示未來時間，要用現在式，不加 will。
主句是未來，when 子句不能用過去式。
when 子句有 will，而且主句也應該表達未來打電話。

why: 時間副詞子句不用 will，用現在式代替未來式。
tip: when、before、after 子句，用現在式代替未來式。
say: I will call you when I arrive.

text: She was tired, _____ she finished the project.
options: but
so
because
if

wrong.so: so 引出結果，但累和完成之間是轉折，不是因果。
wrong.because: because 後面應接原因，but 才能連接相反的情況。
wrong.if: if 表示條件，句子沒有假設的意思。

why: 累了卻仍然完成，兩件事相反，要用 but 連接。
tip: 前後意思相反，就用 but。
say: She was tired, but she finished the project.

prompt: 你想說：「我把食物蓋好，這樣才不會被雨淋濕。」哪句最合適？
options: I covered the food so that it wouldn't get wet.
I covered the food so it didn't to get wet.
I covered the food because it wouldn't get wet.
I covered the food but it wouldn't get wet.
answer: I covered the food so that it wouldn't get wet.

wrong.I covered the food so it didn't to get w: didn't 後面不能加 to，且 so that 比單獨 so 更清楚表示目的。
wrong.I covered the food because it wouldn't g: because 讓句子變成「因為不會濕才蓋」，邏輯顛倒。
wrong.I covered the food but it wouldn't get w: but 是轉折，蓋好食物與不濕並非相反關係。

why: so that 表示目的，後面接 wouldn't get wet，說明蓋食物的目的。
tip: so that 表示為了……，後面接目的。
say: I covered the food so that it wouldn't get wet.

prompt: 哪一句 and 與 or 的用法正確？
options: Do you want tea or coffee?
Do you want tea and coffee?
Do you want tea but coffee?
Do you want tea so coffee?
answer: Do you want tea or coffee?

wrong.Do you want tea and coffee?: and 表示兩者都要，但這裡是請對方二選一。
wrong.Do you want tea but coffee?: but 是轉折，無法表示選擇。
wrong.Do you want tea so coffee?: so 引出結果，不能連接兩個選項。

why: or 表示在兩個選項中選一個，用於詢問選擇。
tip: 二選一用 or，兩個都要用 and。
say: Do you want tea or coffee?

text: _____ I was cooking, the power went out.
options: While
Unless
Although
Since

wrong.Unless: Unless 是「除非」，不符合事件的時間關係。
wrong.Although: Although 是讓步，句子沒有轉折。
wrong.Since: Since 是「自從」或「因為」，不適合在這裡表示同時發生。

why: While 表示「當……的時候」，說明做菜的同時停電了。
tip: while 引導正在進行的動作背景。
say: While I was cooking, the power went out.

text: Even though the forecast said sunny, those clouds look dark.
options: 預報說晴天，但雲看起來很黑
預報說下雨，所以雲很黑
天氣一定會放晴
沒有雲，天氣很好
answer: 預報說晴天，但雲看起來很黑

wrong.預報說下雨，所以雲很黑: 原句預報說的是 sunny（晴天）。
wrong.天氣一定會放晴: even though 引出相反的現象，說明天氣可能不如預報。
wrong.沒有雲，天氣很好: 句子說 clouds look dark，有雲。

why: even though 引出與預報相反的現象，所以雲看起來很黑，暗示天氣可能不好。
tip: even though 後面的情況，與主句形成對比。
say: Even though the forecast said sunny, those clouds look dark.

prompt: 哪一句 before 與 after 的用法正確？
options: Wash your hands before you eat.
Wash your hands before you will eat.
Wash your hands after you ate dinner tomorrow.
Wash your hands before eat you.
answer: Wash your hands before you eat.

before 子句不用 will，用現在式。
wrong.Wash your hands after you ate dinner tom: tomorrow 是未來，after 子句不能用過去式。
子句語序要主詞在前：before you eat。

why: before 子句用現在式；主詞加動詞的順序是 you eat。
tip: before 後面接子句，用主詞加動詞。
say: Wash your hands before you eat.
